name: DTIALPS
title: DTI-ALPS Index

description.short: Automatically computes the DTI-ALPS index from DSI Studio QSDR output
description.long: SlicerDTIALPS automatically computes the DTI-ALPS (Diffusion Tensor Image Analysis along the Perivascular Space) index from DSI Studio QSDR output (tensor components + FA). It features fixed MNI-coordinate ROIs, automatic FA scale detection, and data-quality QC warnings.

acknowledgments.text: ALPS method: Taoka et al., Jpn J Radiol 2017. ROI coordinates: Barisano et al. / Liu et al.

features: Computes left/right/mean DTI-ALPS index from DSI Studio txx/tyy/tzz/FA NIfTI files
Fixed MNI ROI coordinates (proj_L/R, assoc_L/R) with spherical masks
